inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: Are overhead electric utility lines shown on this site plan? If so, what is their voltage classification or labeling (distribution vs. transmission)? What is the extent and location of these overhead lines relative to the proposed development?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing sheet discovery and feature presence/identification (asking whether OHE lines exist on the plan, their voltage class, and general location), not yet measuring lateral distance from trees to conductors. The measurement phase comes after confirming presence and understanding the OHE extent.
